name: Sikaplan® WP Protection Sheet-15 HE
summary: Sikaplan® WP Protection Sheet-15 HE is a homogeneous protective membrane with an embossed surface, based on polyvinylchloride (PVC-p).
metaDescription: Sikaplan® WP Protection Sheet-15 HE is a homogeneous protective membrane with an embossed surface, based on polyvinylchloride (PVC-p).
attributes: Embossed surface to allow proper spreading of repair injection material
High dimensional stability under permanent pressure and heat
Suitable for contact with acidic soft water and alkaline environments
Resistant to root penetration and micro-organisms
Can be installed on damp and even wet substrates
usage: Protection of waterproofing membranes on base of PVC-p, also in combination with injection backup systems.
advantages: Embossed surface to allow proper spreading of repair injection material

packaging: Roll size | 2.20 m (width) x roll length individual and as specified

items.label: APPROVALS / CERTIFICATES
items.text: Quality Management System EN ISO 9001/ ISO 14001

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: 5 years shelf life from date of production if stored properly in undamaged, unopened, original sealed packaging

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Rolls must be stored in their original packaging, in a horizontal position and in cool and dry conditions. They must be protected from direct sunlight, rain, snow and ice, etc. Do not stack pallets of rolls during transport or storage.

items.label: System structure
items.text:
Ancillary Products:
All Sikaplan® WP (PVC based) membranes

items.label: Resistance to impact
items.text:
Watertight at 500 mm drop height | (EN 12691)
(500 g falling weight, Method A)

items.label: SUBSTRATE QUALITY
items.text: Substrate conditions are as defined for the waterproofing membrane system which is to be protected with the Sikaplan® WP Protection Sheet-15 HE.
